item.title: Fresno City Leaders threaten ordinance to bar registered sex offenders from city buildings
item.description: Fresno City Leaders are moving forward with plans for an ordinance that would bar a potential council candidate, who is a registered sex offender, from being able to enter various city facilities.

item.title: US and Israel launch joint strike in Iran, US official says
item.description: Israel and the US have launched a joint attack on Iran, officials say. President Trump confirmed the US military began "major combat operations."

item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: Police search for man involved in chase, hit-and-run in Central Fresno
item.description: The Fresno Police Department is searching for a hit-and-run suspect who led officers on a pursuit that ended in a crash near McKinley and Fruit shortly before midnight on Friday.

item.description: Three suspects are in custody after a shooting in Tulare sent a child to the hospital.

item.description: The airstrikes that killed hundreds of Iranians on Saturday are now causing people across the world to take a stance.

item.title: 2026 CIF Central Section High School Basketball championships at Selland Arena
item.description: Downtown Fresno is buzzing with action on the court. The 2026 CIF Central Section High School Basketball Finals are happening this weekend at Selland Arena.

item.title: Fresno runners get first look at new police helicopter at Support the Blue Run
item.description: Thousands of participants at the 11th Annual Support the Blue Run were among the first to see the Fresno Police Department's new multi‑million‑dollar helicopter on Saturday at Woodward Park in Northeast Fresno.
